name: sbozor
description: SBOZOR — root orkestratsiya skriptlari. Xostda `make` yo'q (Windows), shuning uchun barcha yorliqlar shu yerda.

scripts.up: docker compose up -d db cache storage core-api worker scheduler cv-service go2rtc --wait
scripts.migrate: docker compose --profile migrate run --rm migrate alembic upgrade head
scripts.revision: docker compose --profile migrate run --rm migrate alembic revision --autogenerate -m
scripts.test: docker compose --profile test run --rm tests pytest -q
scripts.test:unit: docker compose --profile test run --rm tests pytest tests/unit -x -q
scripts.test:fast: docker compose --profile test run --rm tests pytest tests/unit -x -q
scripts.test:tenancy: docker compose --profile test run --rm tests pytest tests/tenancy -q
scripts.sim:up: docker compose --profile sim up -d nvr-sim nvr-sim-rtsp go2rtc storage --wait
scripts.sim:down: docker compose --profile sim stop nvr-sim nvr-sim-rtsp go2rtc storage
scripts.test:sim: npm run sim:up && docker compose --profile test run --rm tests pytest tests/integration -m "sim and not slow" -x -q
scripts.test:sim:slow: npm run sim:up && docker compose --profile test run --rm tests pytest tests/integration -m "sim and slow" -x -q
scripts.lint: docker compose --profile test run --rm tests sh -c "ruff check . && ruff format --check . && mypy ."
scripts.cv:test: docker compose --profile test run --rm cv-tests pytest -q
scripts.cv:lint: docker compose --profile test run --rm cv-tests sh -c "ruff check . && ruff format --check . && mypy ."
scripts.//gate-budget: BYUDJET 1250 s (W0-13, 05-15 da qayta belgilandi; oldingi qiymat 900 s). Uch o'lchov TINCH XOSTDA: 1009 s (sovuq) / 1004 s / 983 s — tarqoqlik 26 s (eng yomonning 2.6 %). Chegara = eng yomon (1009) + 20 % = 1211, 50 ga yuqoriga yaxlitlandi. O'lchov sharti va nazorat o'lchovi (gate:fast 87 s) .planning/phases/05-kamera-zonalari-cv-va-nazoratchi-tasdig-i/05-VALIDATION.md da. Bu kalit npm uchun IZOH: ishga tushirilmaydi va gate zanjiriga kirmaydi.
scripts.gate: npm run sim:up && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run cv:lint && npm run cv:test && npm --prefix frontend run i18n:check && npm --prefix frontend test && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.//gate-fast-budget: BYUDJET 180 s — O'ZGARMADI. Joriy o'lchov 87 s (tinch xost). 4-fazaning toza bazasi 68 s edi; o'sish to'plamning O'SISHIDAN (vitest 494 -> 620, unit testlar va cv to'plami), ifloslanishdan EMAS — 04-14 dagi ifloslangan qiymat 129 s bo'lgan va u O'ZGARMAGAN ish hajmida olingan edi.
scripts.gate:fast: npm run test:fast && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.karmana:sample: docker compose --profile test run --rm -e PYTHONPATH=tests tests python -m fixtures.karmana_seed --out-dir ops/data/karmana/local
